title: Fast and Scalable Abstract Interpretation for Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.33259v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Abstract interpretation can certify properties of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), but precise analyses remain expensive. General implementations repeat work when analyzing the same architecture under different inputs and properties. Interleaving this work with numerical operations limits GPU utilization and restricts how much of the analysis a tensor compiler can process together.   We present Scepter, a framework for specializing DNN abstract interpreters through structural semantics. The semantics determine the structure of intermediate abstract values while deferring their numerical evaluation. Structural computations from successive operations can therefore be performed together before certification, generating an executable tensor program. translated_title: 面向深度神经网络的快速可扩展抽象解释
translated_abstract: 抽象解释可以认证深度神经网络（DNN）的性质，但精确的分析仍然代价高昂。通用实现在针对不同输入和性质分析相同架构时会重复执行相同的工作。将这项工作与数值运算交错进行会限制GPU的利用率，并限制张量编译器能够一并处理的分析范围。我们提出了Scepter，一个通过结构化语义对DNN抽象解释器进行专门化的框架。该语义确定中间抽象值的结构，同时推迟其数值求值。因此，来自连续操作的结构化计算可以在认证之前一起执行，从而生成一个可执行的张量程序。当抽象解释器和DNN架构固定时，该程序可以在不同权重和输入区域下重复使用。我们证明了它计算出的界与通用解释器计算出的界相同。
tldr: Scepter框架通过结构化语义将DNN抽象解释器的结构计算与数值求值分离，预先编译生成可复用的张量程序，在不损失精度的情况下实现快速且可扩展的神经网络性质认证。
en_tdlr: Scepter leverages structural semantics to decouple structural computation from numerical evaluation in DNN abstract interpreters, compiling them into reusable tensor programs that achieve fast and scalable neural network certification without sacrificing precision.
